title.en: Plenty of contact, not much carry

text.en: The Jays struck out less than almost anyone, yet finished last in MLB in both ISO and Hard-hit%. The result: 4.00 runs a game, the fewest in the majors.
text.zh-TW: 問題不是揮空，而是打不遠：三振率聯盟第 2 低，ISO 和 Hard-hit% 卻都是聯盟第 30。結果是每場 4.00 分，全聯盟最少。

text.en: Home runs fell from 191 to 152, and the outfield lost 28 of them, about 70% of the drop. Newcomer Okamoto's 33 was the bright spot.
text.zh-TW: 全壘打從 191 支降到 152 支，外野就少了 28 支，約佔七成。新加入的 Okamoto 一人 33 轟，是唯一的亮點。

title.en: The middle of the order went quiet

text.en: Springer and Guerrero Jr. lost about 77 runs of Off between them, roughly 60% of the lineup's 128-run decline.
text.zh-TW: Springer 和 Guerrero Jr. 兩人的 Off 合計少了約 77 分，約佔全隊跌幅 128 分的六成。

title.en: Pitching: Cease and the bullpen held
title.zh-TW: 投手：Cease 和牛棚撐住了

text.en: Runs allowed fell from 721 to 694. Cease struck out 34.9% of hitters for 5.5 WAR and the back of the bullpen held; the back of the rotation didn't.
text.zh-TW: 失分從 721 降到 694。Cease 三振率 34.9%、WAR 5.5，牛棚後段也很穩；破口在輪值後段。

text.en: Of the 15 wins lost from 2025, 12 were lost at Rogers Centre; the road record barely moved. August, at 17-11, was the best month.
text.zh-TW: 比 2025 年少贏的 15 場裡，有 12 場在羅杰斯中心，客場戰績和去年差不多。8 月 17-11 是全年最好的月份。

text.en: The run differential says 76-86; they went 79-83, yet 20-24 in one-run games. Next year comes down to three things:
text.zh-TW: 得失分差推算是 76-86，實際 79-83，一分差比賽卻是 20-24。明年要回答的三件事：
